_readme: Sample data for the Paravostra prototype. Edit, commit, and GitHub Pages redeploys in about a minute. Brand ids, SKUs and marketplace codes must match across sections. Marketplace codes: DE, UK, FR, IT, ES, NL, SE, PL, BE, IE, TR. Alert severity: critical, high, medium, low. Case status: Draft, Awaiting Amazon, Needs reply, Resolved. Listing status: live, issue, processing, draft.

alerts.impact: About €410 a day in lost sales
alerts.title: Rosehip face oil 30 ml is suppressed in Germany
alerts.detail: Amazon removed the offer from search after a dangerous goods review flagged a missing safety data sheet (SDS). The listing stays suppressed until the SDS is uploaded and approved.
steps: Upload the supplier SDS under dangerous goods classification in Seller Central.
Open a case to ask for an expedited review if the suppression lasts more than 48 hours.

alerts.impact: About €260 a day in lost sales
alerts.title: Buy Box lost on Cast iron skillet 28 cm in France
alerts.detail: Another seller offers the same ASIN at €39.90 with FBA, 11% below your €44.90. You held the Buy Box 96% of the time over the last 30 days.
steps: Check whether the other seller is authorised by Nordhaus.
If not, report them through Brand Registry as a possible counterfeit or unauthorised seller.
If they are, consider a temporary price match within the agreed minimum price.

alerts.title: Enamelled Dutch oven 5.2 L runs out in about 9 days in Germany
alerts.detail: At the current sales rate, available FBA stock lasts 9 days. The supplier lead time is 8 weeks, so a stockout is likely before new stock arrives.
steps: Review the restock recommendation for this product.
Consider moving units from the UK or France to Germany in the meantime.

alerts.title: 64 units of Yoga mat 6 mm are stranded in Italy
alerts.detail: The units are in an Amazon warehouse but have no active offer, because the Italian listing closed after a price update failed validation.
steps: Relist the offer with a valid price.
If relisting fails, create a removal order or open a case.

alerts.title: Trademark complaint on Resistance band set (5) in the UK
alerts.detail: A rights owner filed a trademark complaint against the listing. Amazon removed the listing and added a policy warning to the account health dashboard.
steps: Confirm with Veloria that the brand name and images are their own.
Submit an appeal with the trademark registration and supplier invoice.
Contact the rights owner if the complaint looks like a mistake.
alerts.source: Seller Central, logged by hand. Account health warnings are not available through the SP-API.

alerts.title: Shipment FBA18K2QW7 arrived 24 units short
alerts.detail: Nordhaus shipped 240 units of Carbon steel wok 32 cm to DTM2. Amazon received 216 and closed the shipment.
steps: Collect the proof of delivery and the packing list.
Open a reconciliation case for the missing units.

alerts.title: Lavender body wash 250 ml is priced at €2.49 in Spain
alerts.detail: The price fell from €9.90 to €2.49 after an automated repricer update. Eleven units sold at the lower price.
steps: Restore the price to €9.90.
Check the repricer rule for Spain.

alerts.title: An unknown seller joined Carbon steel wok 32 cm in Poland
alerts.detail: A seller called HomeStar24 offers the ASIN at 149 zł (about €35), shipped by the merchant. Nordhaus has no reseller agreement with them.
steps: Make a test purchase to check whether the product is genuine.
If it is not, report the seller through Brand Registry.

alerts.title: Shea hand cream 75 ml has no Swedish bullet points
alerts.detail: The Swedish listing shows the English bullet points, which lowers relevance in Swedish search.
steps: Generate Swedish content in Listings.
Review and publish it.

alerts.title: 12 units of Foam roller 45 cm were lost in a French warehouse
alerts.detail: The inventory ledger shows 12 units marked as lost at ORY4, with no automatic reimbursement after 30 days.
steps: Check the reimbursements report.
Open a case to request reimbursement.

cases.subject: Reimbursement for 18 units lost in warehouse

history.text: Opened the case in Seller Central with the inventory ledger extract.
Automatic reply: the case is under investigation, with an answer within 3 business days.

cases.subject: Listing suppressed: safety data sheet review

history.text: Opened the case with the English SDS attached.
Please provide a safety data sheet in French covering sections 1 to 16. Documents in English cannot be accepted for this marketplace.

cases.amazonAsks: A safety data sheet in French, sections 1 to 16.
cases.suggestedNextStep: Ask Alba Botanics for the French SDS, then reply on the case with it attached.

cases.subject: Wrong dimensions causing a higher FBA fee

history.text: Opened the case with the carton measurements and photos.
We have asked the fulfilment centre to remeasure the item.

cases.subject: Brand Registry: add a new brand representative

history.text: Opened the case with the authorisation letter.
The new representative has been added to the brand.

issues.ES: Ingredient review: provide the full INCI list
